get.description:
List products for tenant (customer-facing).

Authentication is optional for public catalogs, required for private catalogs.
- Public catalogs: Can be viewed without authentication (no prices)
- Private catalogs: Require authentication and permission
- Merchants: Can preview their own catalog (full access to their tenant's products).
Requires tenant_id as query parameter.

schema.title: Response List Products Api V1 Customer Catalog Products Get

get.description:
Get product by ID (customer-facing).

Requires authentication (customer or merchant).
- Customers: Uses authenticated user's permissions for catalog access and prices.
- Merchants: Can preview their own catalog (full access to their tenant's products).
Requires tenant_id as query parameter.

Get product by direct link token (bypasses geo restrictions).

Requires customer authentication. Uses authenticated user's permissions.
Prices are still permission-gated.
Direct links work without tenant_id in query (token contains tenant info).

List stores (tenants) that are visible in the marketplace.

Only tenants with show_in_marketplace=true and a non-empty marketplace_slug are returned.
Public endpoint; no authentication required.

schema.title: Response List Stores Api V1 Marketplace Stores Get

get.description:

Returns 404 if the store does not exist or is not visible in the marketplace.

List marketplace-visible products for a single store (tenant) by slug.

Same permission rules as list_marketplace_products: prices only if authenticated
and customer has can_view_price for this tenant. Private catalogs require
can_view_catalog. Public endpoint; auth optional for price visibility.

schema.title: Response List Store Products Api V1 Marketplace Stores  Slug  Products Get

get.description:
List marketplace-visible products across all tenants.

Public endpoint - no authentication required to view products.
Authentication is optional - if user is logged in, prices will be shown based on permissions.

Products are filtered by:
- marketplace_visible = true
- Geo-filtering (if country code provided)

Prices are permission-gated per tenant (only shown if user is authenticated and has permission).
